subject: Embargoed rollout: manager materials + forms for annual review window
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: HR Compliance <hr-compliance@consulting-hr.com>
Date: Fri, 28 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Embargoed rollout: manager materials + forms for annual review window

Team —

I put together a draft manager packet and the employee notice that we plan to keep under embargo until the leadership preview week. High-level plan below (looking for quick sign-off so we can freeze copy next Tue):

- Goal: Lock manager-facing guidance, forms, and escalation contacts for the review window. Embargoed distribution to managers 2026-09-07; full employee notice release 2026-09-14.
- Preview: Leadership-only preview (read-only) 2026-09-01 to 2026-09-03.
- Compliance checks: Need privacy/EU redlines by 2026-08-31. HR Compliance (cc'd) — can you confirm the attached quick-check?
- Translations: If we need translations, request cutoff is 2026-09-02 (limited scope: DE, FR).

Attachments: manager_packet_v3.docx (master), employee_notice_embargoed_template.md, privacy_quickcheck_EU.pdf

Asks:
1) Marcus — can you skim the manager guidance for escalation language and confirm it is consistent with our existing SLA for sensitive roles?
2) Lauren — please review the communication cadence and advise whether the manager webinar on 2026-09-08 should be live or recorded-first.
3) HR Compliance — please flag any GDPR / data retention wording we must change before the leadership preview.

I intentionally kept the packet concise — bullet-first, scripts for difficult conversations, and a short manager checklist for local leads. If we can lock by EOD Tue (8/31), I'll schedule the preview and lock the embargo.

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
People Operations Manager, Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.ai
(attachment: manager_packet_v3.docx)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 28 Aug 2026 11:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Embargoed rollout: manager materials + forms for annual review window

Thanks Mina — quick pass below. Overall looks solid. A few inline things:

- Escalation language: change wording in section "When to escalate" to reference the on-call escalation list rather than the generic "People Ops." That avoids misrouting for international offices.
- Confidentiality clause: add a single-line reminder under the manager packet header: "These materials are embargoed — do not forward outside leadership and your direct reports."
- Forms: the manager calibration form looks good but please add a checkbox for "sensitive role (legal/infra/customer data)" so we have a clear triage bucket.

Minor Qs:
- Do we want a short manager script for folks who ask for concrete examples of behavior? If so I can draft a one-pager.
- Translation scope: I support DE/FR but recommend adding JP for APAC small team leads — will that blow the timeline?

For legal/redline: CC'd HR Compliance is the right call. If they can't turn by Mon morning, we should push preview to Wed.

—Marcus
Marcus Lin | Director, Engineering Productivity | marcus_lin@redwood.ai
(attachment referenced: none)

- Webinar: recorded-first. We'll run a short live AMA the day after release (2026-09-09) for teams with questions. Recorded-first reduces risk of accidental leaks.
